title: Night lights: off on vacancy regardless of exit action; on in Sleep even under sleep protection (main lights still gated)
summary: v5.103.42 rule shipped, then live found Living Room night light on all night (exit_light_action=leave_on governed OFF) -> 5.103.43 turns rule-lit night lights off on vacancy except leave-on-when-empty lights, and uses Sleep colour from house Sleep via a narrow helper (a first draft that dropped the sleep-protection gate would have switched main lights off in Sleep - both reviews blocked it). Operator ruling (a) -> 5.103.44: under the sleep-protection motion gate (bypass=3) occupied rooms still get night lights; gated exits turn them off.
why: Operator: night lights should generally come on during sleep; sleep protection exists to suppress main lights, not night lights. Master Toilet got no light at 04:49 because the gate short-circuited all automation and the reconciler is state-change driven.
implications: Several stale test oracles encoded the old entry_action contract and had to be updated (verified both controllers first). Operator HA night-light automations stay ON until each room's URA automation is turned on by the operator; then turned off, never deleted.
alternatives_considered: (b) keep waiting for the 3rd motion under sleep protection - rejected by operator
revisit_trigger: Night light left on after vacancy, or main lights changed by night-light paths.
